_README: Owner-approved defaults (ADR-0017). Historical GICS and historical PIT S&P
membership are OPTIONAL context and never block Paper or Live trading.
No paid data source is required.

gics._note: FREE_RECONSTRUCTED is non-authoritative, current-only, and may inform analytics only. It can never become a trading veto.

universe._note: A CURRENT list is required only for SP500_CURRENT strategies. Historical PIT membership is never substituted for it.

historical_pit_membership.required_for_backtest: PIT_STRICT only, and only for index-restricted strategies

backtest._note: An APPROXIMATE run reports its survivorship and look-ahead limitations. A PIT_STRICT request that cannot be met returns INCOMPLETE rather than a quietly downgraded run.

paid_sources._note: Licensed GICS and any paid feed remain optional future upgrades.
